name: f2-convert-on-review-v1
hypothesis: Early Skill/Network investment pays only if the policy never lets a second weak review happen. If the first C/D review (or feedback that the next review must improve) forces an immediate, all-in CONVERT to visible delivery that holds until a B-or-better review, plus a permanent delivery hedge afterwards, and risk signals trigger Defuse legacy risk, then the run avoids both observed elimination modes (capability dismissal after a second weak review; trust crisis after a second blow-up) while keeping F2's late Level/Skill gains, so it completes 48 months more often than F2-v1 and P0 and ends with higher quantitative_score than F2-v1 and F3-v1.
change: Recombination of F2 (stage machine BUILD->CONVERT) and F3 (risk signal states and weak-review plan). vs F2-v1: (1) the first weak review or 'next must improve' feedback is framed as an emergency and switches at once; (2) CONVERT spends every free Energy point on Prepare report materials (no High-intensity work, no Skill learning) and uses Report results / Showcase results as main action; (3) exit from CONVERT requires a B-or-better review (F2 required a promotion plus B), and after leaving CONVERT, Prepare report materials permanently replaces Network maintenance in BUILD; (4) if the next grade is still weak, stay in CONVERT and retarget the main action to the factor named by the feedback (from F3); (5) adds F3's Clear/Raised/Escalating risk state with Defuse legacy risk first after a signal, problem-closing story choices, and no new commitments when escalating; Escalating overrides the main action only outside CONVERT; (6) explicit priority order wellbeing > risk > stage. vs F3-v1: drops the Clear-state balanced play in favour of F2's BUILD stage and drops the check_latest_logs-after-warning rule. Single Skill, about 445 words (F2-v1 444, F3-v1 483).
predicted_behaviour: Before the first review: same BUILD signature as F2-v1 (Skill learning + Network maintenance, mentorship/rotation/key project). In the first quarterly phase after any C/D or 'must improve' feedback: notes switch to 'CONVERT', all free Energy goes to Prepare report materials and the main action is Report results to your manager or Showcase results; no Skill learning until a B-or-better review. After that review, notes return to 'BUILD' and every later quarter contains Prepare report materials. Defuse legacy risk appears in the first Energy phase after a risk signal (short warning-to-defuse lag, like F3) and its frequency tracks signals. Zero or near-zero runs with two consecutive weak reviews; fewer capability dismissals than F2-v1 and M3; first-review grades no better than F2-v1; later reviews at B or better more often than F2-v1.
refutation: Refuted if, on paired runs, it is not eliminated less often than F2-v1 (in particular for repeated low performance) or its mean quantitative_score is not above F2-v1 and F3-v1. Refuted as a mechanism if runs still show two weak reviews in a row after a CONVERT switch that was actually executed (CONVERT does not lift grades), or if completed runs lose F2's Level/Skill advantage over F4 (the early investment no longer pays once the hedge is added). Manipulation fails if the switch to CONVERT lags the first weak review by more than one quarterly phase, if Skill learning continues during CONVERT, or if Defuse legacy risk is not concentrated after risk signals.
notes: All triggers are state- and feedback-based; no calendar months, no thresholds. 'Repeated weak reviews can end the run' is a qualitative restatement of the published 'repeated low performance' failure direction, not a counter. 'Near the end' uses only the published run length. Grade meanings (C/D weak, B solid) are published. Notes are one line, well under the observed 1,000-character truncation. Diagnosis for P15 bookkeeping: target_failure = capability dismissal after weak reviews and trust crisis after accumulated risk (Claude workers, small n); alternative diagnosis = weak reviews come from low Network/relationships or hidden risk rather than low Output, in which case CONVERT's Output focus will not lift grades and the retarget rule must carry the recovery. Compliance lint: 0 errors, 0 review flags.
